title: Qurrium: A Python package for randomized measurement-based estimation of quantum state properties
summary: Estimating quantum state properties is essential across a wide range of applications, from studying quantum many-body physics to benchmarking quantum hardware. We present Qurrium, a Python package built on Qiskit that implements randomized measurement protocols for estimating purity, second-order Rényi entropy, expectation values of Pauli observables, and state overlap. In this paper, we focus on the classical shadow protocol and demonstrate two workflows in Qurrium.
